name: Pond's Pinkish Glow Translucent Facial Powder 50g Pinkish Bright Powder
description:
Pond's Pinkish Glow Translucent Facial Powder – 50g

Pinkish Bright Powder | Made in Thailand

Key Features:

Pinkish Glow Effect – Smooths and brightens skin for a natural, radiant look.

Double UV Protection – Shields against both UVA & UVB rays.

Soft & Fresh Feel – Keeps skin comfortable and refreshed throughout the day.

Oil Control Formula – Absorbs excess oil to maintain a matte finish.

Covers Imperfections – Helps conceal dark circles and uneven skin tone.

Safe for Skin – Allergy-tested and dermatologist-tested.

Benefits:

Provides a soft, pinkish glow with a natural finish

Keeps skin matte, smooth, and shine-free all day

Protects from harmful sun exposure

Enhances skin brightness while maintaining comfort
